Cross-category dedup check confirms both URLs already recorded as leaves in Textile.xlsx (cross_category_url_index.json returns ['Textile.xlsx'] for both, using the bare-domain form indiacircus.com; the www-prefixed form is absent from the index but is the same site/URL). No other bath/shower/toilet/vanity/basin/faucet/tap/soap/toothbrush/bidet/mirror-bathroom terms found in nav or sitemap_pages.xml (which only lists static informational pages, not the category tree, so the mega-menu nav was used as the tree source, confirmed exhaustive against sitemap findings). Conclusion: confirmed absence of genuine Bathroom category -- everything under the site's 'Bath' node is textile, already captured in Textile.xlsx.
